description.en: Returns the direction, in degrees, from one character to another: GetRyLookAtPos with the second character's position (CMND_GET_POSRY). No shipped script calls it.

examples.case: Turning toward another character, computed by hand (not found in script_clean/; invented)
examples.code:
local ry = GetRyLookAtChara(hTenmaL, hAoiL);
EvLowMdlSetRotY(hTenmaL, ry, 20);
